name: Dynavik Delight [Racial]
body:
Making a dynavik happy is as easy as losing a few gallons of blood.

Prerequisite(s): Dynavik, natural weapons, BAB +6

Benefit(s): Your natural attacks deal 1 point of bleed damage on a successful hit. This stacks with the existing bleed damage a target is suffering. You no longer take a penalty to AC from using your talon attacks.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
